title_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Faze Perfundimtare !!
description_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Faze Perfundimtare !! Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 97.7 m² dhe ndodhet ne katin e 7 banim nga 8 te godines te pajisur me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet ne korridorin hyres me pas salloni i ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon me kendin e ngrenies dhe gatimit i cili ka dritare me vete, dhoma matrimoniale e gjumit me tualet te dedikuar, dhoma tjeter e gjumit, nje tualet i dyte dhe lavanteria. Apartamenti orientohet nga Lindja. Kompleksi rezidencial ku ndodhet ky apartament ofron të gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme duke ofruar qetësi, atmosferë relaksuese, siguri, lehtësinë dhe komoditetin e një qyteti të vogël. Rezidenca ofron shkollë dhe kopësht publik, securtity 24/7, qendër shëndetsore, njësi tregtare shërbimi, transport publik brenda kompleksit, hapësira të gjelbëruara dhe rekreative ndër më të mëdhatë në vend ,park qendror, kënde sportive, kënde lojrash për fëmije, hapësira për parkim. Apartamenti disponon dhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra 16.000 euro.
title_en: At Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in the final phase!!
description_en: At Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in the final phase!! The apartment has a total area of ​​97.7 m² and is located on the 7th floor of the 8th residential building equipped with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the entrance corridor behind the living room with access to the balcony with the dining and cooking corner which has its own window, a matrimonial bedroom with a dedicated toilet, another bedroom, a second toilet and a laundry room. The apartment faces East. The residential complex where this apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities offering calmness, relaxing atmosphere, security, ease and comfort of a small town. The residence offers a public school and kindergarten, 24/7 security, health center, commercial service units, public transport within the complex, green and recreational spaces among the largest in the country, central park, sports areas, children's playgrounds, parking spaces. The apartment also has a parking post with an extra price of 16,000 euros.
